outcome: Expression of NeuN and glial fibrillary acidic protein
Expression of ECS/AEs enzymes (DAGLalpha, NAPE-PLD, FAAH) in hippocampus
Expression of ECS/AEs receptors (CB1, PPARalpha) in hippocampus
cohort: Postweaned rats subjected to induced perinatal asphyxia and controls (spontaneous or cesarean delivery).
finding: Perinatal asphyxia in rats led to impaired recognition and spatial reference memory, hippocampal astrogliosis, and specific changes in the expression of hippocampal endocannabinoid system (ECS) enzymes and receptors, notably a decrease in NAPE-PLD and PPARalpha.
mod_finding: Postweaned cesarean delivery rats, used as controls, showed an increase in FAAH immunolabeling in the hippocampal CA3 area.
